stopping_behavior.rationale: The conversation ended mid-clarification with repeated incomplete questions and no READY_TO_MODEL or final modeling state. Project (1) timing was only partially addressed, and project (3)/(4) investment timing was never clarified.

summary: The agent recovered project (1) reinvestment and project (2) recovery timing, but its questions were often truncated or vague, it missed the project (3) and (4) investment-timing restrictions, and it ended without a final model.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.
